description:
Story 1 of fz-kdt.69's cold-reviewed v2 design (read the parent FIRST -- the
measured foundation and hazards live there). FIRST because nothing else is
safe while retraction is self-undoing.

## The defect
demand_fact_producer's Activation|ActivationInputs -> Job::SeedActivation arm
(drive.rs:249-251) answers for EVERY such wait -- including a retracted
caller-discovered key's own analysis blocking on its gate
(jobs/semantic.rs:70-79). seed_activation (jobs/root.rs:116-129) then
unconditionally publishes Activation(k) AND ActivationInputs(k) with rows
FABRICATED from the key's own arrow (activation.inputs(world.types())) -- a
lossy reconstruction (post-convergence_collapse for recursive bodies) whose
rows join into cumulative ActivationInputs permanently. Measured: with
preservation off, SeedActivation runs 27->73 on enum_take_drop_split.

## The fix
1. SeedActivation stops answering for caller-discovered keys: only keys a
   root or latent-executable path legitimately seeds get the arm. World knows
   which (root entries, latent executables) -- find the authoritative record
   and gate there (in seed_activation or the producer arm, whichever keeps
   the producer map static and the judgment where the knowledge lives).
2. analyze_activation's self-gate CONCLUDES instead of waiting when its
   Activation fact is absent: an ordinary conclusion, reads recorded
   unconditionally (the engine's unconditional-read rule) so a first/later
   appearance re-wakes it.

## Hazards (probe before building)
- MEASURE first: how often does the self-gate's wait path fire in production
  at HEAD (three target fixtures)? If ~never, the conclude change is
  behavior-neutral today and load-bearing only for Story 3 -- say so.
- A conclusion REPLACES outputs: concluding empty from the gate must not
  withdraw standing claims of a LIVE activation. kdt.63 preservation covers
  Activation/CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets on non-rebased conclusions;
  ReturnType/ActivationAnalyzed are not preserved -- check whether the
  gate-conclusion can retract them and design deliberately (e.g. re-list
  standing outputs, or prove the path unreachable for live keys today).
- Roots/latent/macro paths must keep working: SeedRoot, macro_root,
  latent-executable ignition all traverse this machinery -- enumerate the
  legitimate SeedActivation demand sources and pin each with a test.

## RIP-OUT RULE (owner directive, non-negotiable): any code this change makes
dead -- fabrication branches in seed_activation, producer-arm cases, doc
text describing self-resurrection -- is DELETED in this same commit, with a
deletion list in the commit message. Superseding without deleting = deferral
requiring authorization.

## Acceptance
- RED first: retract Activation(k) for a caller-discovered key; assert
  SeedActivation(k) never runs and the key stays absent.
- Instrument: with preservation env-disabled (probe-only), SeedActivation
  counts fall from 73/7/27 to <=27/6/20 (the preserve-ON numbers).
- All pins/gates: inventory 59/221/214, kdt.63 ratchets, zero-uncaused,
  byte-identical backend, determinism suite, lib/fz2_cli/matrix 0 failed.
- Docs: fact-engine/semantic-fixpoint sections touching seeding updated,
  self-resurrection text deleted.
